sentences.text: Radar feels like it sees everything.
It doesn’t, and each blind spot has put a boat ashore.
The radar horizon is only a little beyond the visual horizon.
A low target past it won’t show.
A low, sandy beach may barely return an echo.
So what’s the first strong echo you see as you close the coast?
It may be the condos, or higher ground well inland.
You think you’re two miles off, and you’re one.
Small fiberglass, wooden and rubber boats return weak echoes.
That’s why a radar reflector is worth having.
Big ships and islands cast shadows, and hide whatever’s behind them.
And radar shows false echoes: side lobes, and multiple echoes bouncing between you and a nearby ship.
